description: ⚠️ Destructive: Permanently delete a Global DNS domain. A domain that still has records other than SOA/NS is rejected (X00006): delete the records with ncloud_dns_delete_records, publish with ncloud_dns_apply_domain, then delete the domain. Set confirm=true to execute.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

name: ncloud_dns_delete_domain
